item.tib: drung mu ha ra'i dngos grub thob tshul
item.coloph: de ltar gcod gdams rin chen 'phreng ba yis (yi) lo rgyus don gsal sgron ma 'di/ slob mas rab bskul yi ger bkod/ che bzhi med pa'i lo rgyus la/ mi g+ha res yid ches med pas yus/ 'on kyang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gros che bzhi mdzod/ khyad par rang sems dpang du btsug 'gro ba'i don du dar rgyas 'phel bar shog gcod gdams bla ma mkha' 'gros lung ci ltar gnang ba ltar/ stong thun lo rgyus yi ger bkod pa/ don gsal sgron ma bya ba rdzogs so/ drung mu ha ra nas rim gyis brgyud nas// bkra shis//
